The legacy locale_panic adapter wraps its supplied message before locale_panic_sv attaches panic context and throws. Keep this opaque compatibility path and errno restoration intact.

Perl_Gv_AMupdate cannot resolve the named implementation of an overload operator, distinguishing a missing method from a cache/import stub through its selector. This is overload resolution, not a conflict between composed native roles.
The legacy Perl_assert macro reports a false C condition with its source filename and line. Keep DEBUGGING and buffer/Coverity guards and the non-core public macro behavior.
PERL_REENTRANT_LOCK sees xcounter zero and rcounter positive. Upgrading this read lock to exclusive could deadlock with another reader; preserve the untrusted reader-count marker and all counters.
The exclusive-lock acquisition path has xcounter zero and rcounter negative. This is a corrupt per-thread nesting count, not a negative count of total readers.

After incrementing an already owned exclusive lock, PERL_REENTRANT_LOCK evaluates the caller supplied prohibition condition. The increment itself did not fail. Preserve the stringified condition and reliable-reader marker.
Exclusive-lock acquisition reaches xcounter below zero after handling zero and positive counts. Preserve signed counter data rather than casting it for plural selection.
PERL_REENTRANT_UNLOCK handles xcounter one or above one, then rejects a nonpositive exclusive ownership count. No underlying mutex release occurs on this branch.

PERL_REENTRANT_READ_LOCK reaches its final arm when both counters are nonpositive and at least one is negative. Its existing text mentions xcounter only, which is narrower than the predicate. Preserve wording here and record a separate follow-up.
PERL_REENTRANT_READ_UNLOCK handles one and greater-than-one read nesting counts; its final arm rejects rcounter zero or negative before releasing a read lock.
WARN_HELPER_ requires RExC_copy_start_in_constructed before translating a compiler warning pointer into original-pattern coordinates.
PERL_REPORT_LOCATION_BEFORE_LENGTH clamps past-end pointers but panics when the translated original-pattern offset is negative.

Named method search exhausted direct, inherited and permitted AUTOLOAD resolution in an existing package. Tie constructors have the same missing-method contract; normalize their C inputs and retain DIE delivery through an alias.
Named method search cannot resolve a package stash and emits its existing perhaps-forgot-to-load hint. Tie constructor paths share this contract after normalizing their method-name inputs.
Perl_gv_autoload_pvn rejects an inherited AUTOLOAD when GV_AUTOLOAD_ISMETHOD is absent. The failing call is explicitly a non-method, so it belongs to callable lookup rather than Object.

missingterm constructs the expected terminator spelling from its explicit input or parser delimiter state and reports unterminated strings/documents. Preserve quoting, UTF8 flags and renderer location handling.
The lexer cannot recognize a source character and records the character, preceding span and computed near-column value. The source-line fallback and UTF8 length logic are preserved.
The bareword lexer consumes a package separator but scans no following component, retaining the preceding name and separator in the diagnostic.
The CORE-qualified word tokenizer finds no reserved keyword after excluding qualified-name forms.

re_op_compile and engine growth report failed regex allocations. study_chunk also uses the identity for minimum-length and repeated-string arithmetic overflow near SSize_t_MAX. It is not solely out of memory.
The (?R) and (?0) whole-pattern subroutine-call forms require an immediate closing parenthesis. This is call syntax, not a runtime infinite-recursion error.
S_reg has re eval enabled but no matching precompiled code-block record at the current source offset. Without re eval the same condition reports the ordinary runtime-code-disabled error.
A (?{...}) or (??{...}) code block has no matching precompiled block entry and runtime re-eval is not enabled. Enabled re-eval with missing metadata has its distinct internal panic.
Each S_reg caller requires a regbranch result after propagating valid restart flags. All four producers share this contract.
The regex compiler increments RExC_npar and rejects the U16_MAX boundary before allocating more capture metadata. The reported count is retained.
After top-level regex compilation, leftover non-closing-parenthesis input reaches the explicit cannot-happen compiler guard. Ordinary unmatched ) has its own user diagnostic.
regbranch requires regpiece to return a node after handling TRYAGAIN and supported restart flags.
regpiece requires regatom to return a node after handling supported restart flags and TRYAGAIN.
grok_bslash_N reparses a constructed subpattern for the named escape and requires a node after restoring the outer parser and propagating restart flags.
regatom requires regclass results for bracket classes and single-value class escapes after checking their supported restart flags.
regatom requires a nested reg result after handling TRYAGAIN and restart flags.
Both regatom escape paths detect a terminal backslash at RExC_end; embedded NUL is handled separately.
Both literal-run and bracket-class callers request single-codepoint output from grok_bslash_N and treat NEED_UTF8 on its false result as an internal protocol violation.

While splitting an EXACTish node, regatom maps a temporary locale-folded string back to original source bytes and requires a nonzero loc_correspondence entry. This producer is compile-time, not matching.
handle_regex_sets requires regclass to return a node for an operand or the reconstructed final class after propagating valid restarts.
skip_to_be_ignored_text scans a (?#...) comment and hits RExC_end before its closing parenthesis. This does not refer to /x line comments.
study_chunk checks lookbehind minimum and variable length against U8_MAX, including negative or overflowing width deltas. The alternate feature-guarded study path has the same bound.
DEBUGGING regprop detects an opcode above REGNODE_MAX with a compiler state and includes the pattern context through FAIL_. Keep separate from the no-state form.

The regex context renderer wraps its already-rendered child message together with before/after pattern spans. Runtime context completion also uses this catalog identity. It is a contextual wrapper, not a new regex grammar failure.
A missing key in a readonly/restricted hash rejects ordinary fetch/store access, but an exists probe remains permitted. Keep the keyed diagnostic separate from readonly-value deletion.
Deletion of an absent/disallowed restricted-hash key is rejected. The existing-key readonly-value deletion has a separate mutation diagnostic and remains distinct.

Perl_taint_proper dispatches the standard dependency format while TAINT_get is true. Context selectors retain setuid/setgid/taint-warning/taint-mode provenance; -t/-U can use warning delivery without changing the existing subject class.
Perl_taint_env detects that the ENV hash no longer has the required environment magic while its glob still has the ENV name. It reports hash aliasing through the shared taint policy dispatcher.
The same environment-magic check finds a glob name other than ENV and reports that glob alias target. It is distinct from generic hash aliasing.

The standard insecure-operation format is used for tainted environment paths and OS2 shell handling. Its operation text and contextual selector are preserved; it is not restricted to one environment variable.
Perl_taint_env finds MgTAINTEDDIR on PATH or a VMS DCL$PATH entry and reports the unsafe search directory. It is separate from the string taint flag on that variable.
Perl_taint_env rejects tainted shell-control environment variables and a tainted TERM containing disallowed characters. The selected variable name and taint execution context are retained.

Perl_taint_proper preserves external C callers that supply a custom format with the historical operation/context values. Unknown external format text is an explicit compatibility boundary, not an unconverted internal literal.
prime_env_iter expects mailbox data from its spawned environment-listing subprocess. A different nonzero sender PID is rejected; zero sender notifications are skipped. Keep PID/message data.
PERL_SNPRINTF_CHECK rejects a reported output length larger than the destination bound; it wraps native printf-family APIs.
JMPENV_PUSH handles exactly setjmp statuses 0 through 3 and rejects every other result before installing the new environment.

utf8_hop_forward_overshoot rejects a nonzero forward hop starting at or beyond end only when no remaining-count output is supplied. Zero hops and caller-handled overshoot remain valid; preserve pluralization and all pointer/count inputs.
Perl_get_context uses the old pthread_getspecific output-parameter API and reports its nonzero error result. Modern pthread and Mach paths do not use this diagnostic.
The internal bucket allocator rejects a DEBUGGING request with negative long conversion. Its PTRDIFF_MAX check and actual allocation exhaustion behavior remain separate.

review_status: applied; all eight ordinary Memory producers reviewed
rationale: The optional Perl allocator rejects the sentinel bucket beyond its representable request-size buckets. This is a request-size limit, not evidence that a representable allocation returned NULL.
The internal bucket allocator checks a non-NULL free pointer against MEM_ALIGNBYTES under DEBUGGING before interpreting its allocation header.
The internal bucket realloc DEBUGGING guard rejects a request whose long conversion is negative. Preserve its no-size message contract and the later NULL-pointer malloc path.
ASSERT_CURPAD_LEGAL requires matching compilation/current arrays, or both absent. It permits an inactive but consistent pair and is DEBUGGING-only.
ASSERT_CURPAD_ACTIVE requires a non-NULL compilation pad with matching current storage. Preserve this stronger precondition rather than merging with the legal-pair check.
Tainting must be enabled early enough; the wrapper also checks startup allocator configuration, so the producer is not exclusively shebang processing.
S_pending_ident handles a pin before declaring pattern bindings and requires scalar sigil plus an existing lexical pad entry. A pin refers to an existing value rather than declaring a new capture.

pp_enterdispatch sees the compiler-set named-subject marker but its first child is not a scalar assignment with children. perly.y constructs that assignment before setting the marker; the failed contract is the generated optree layout.

The named-subject assignment target is neither PADSV nor PADSV_STORE. The grammar declares a scalar lexical before constructing this assignment, so this guard checks the generated subject representation.
Both compile-time reservation summation and runtime retained-capture AV growth reject sizes beyond SSize_t_MAX. This is a representational capacity limit, not invalid clause grammar.

Concat validation permits literal strings, scalar captures and scalar pins. Runtime flattening also rejects missing or unflattenable component trees. All producers enforce the same restricted concatenation shape language.
Concat matching cannot materialize a component as a supported fixed value after excluding capture nodes. This belongs to shape concatenation, not general string concatenation.
Before tentative bindings, concat matching compares capture pad offsets and rejects a second occurrence of the same capture.
Concat matching requires a nonempty fixed boundary between captures, including when intervening fixed fragments materialize to empty strings.
Validation and node compilation both use S_dispatch_pattern_assignment_parts to require a scalar PADSV target for the capture assignment.
Pattern preparation detects RXf_EVAL_SEEN on an embedded matching regexp and rejects regex code blocks in a dispatch shape. It does not prohibit ordinary regexp eval outside this feature.
The compile-time boundary walk tracks whether a nonempty constant has followed a capture and rejects a subsequent capture without it. Pins do not count as constant separators.
S_dispatch_pattern_note_hash_key stores constant keys in a seen hash and rejects duplicates; both hash shapes and object-field shapes share this key uniqueness contract.
Object field validation accepts empty fields or LIST-shaped field pairs; any other nonempty representation is rejected.
An object ellipsis cannot occur while a field value is pending, after another ellipsis, or after a slurp. Complete pairs must precede it.
An object slurp is rejected when a field value is pending or an ellipsis or previous slurp has already occurred.
After an object slurp, a later ordinary field element is forbidden.
An ordinary object-field element follows an already-open ellipsis. The failure is ordering, not a failed OS or mutation operation.
At each object key position the compiler requires OP_CONST. Field values are recursively validated shapes.
Object-field validation ends with need_value set, meaning the final key has no matching value shape.

The call scanner rejects multiple callable targets; the executor also rejects explicit arguments to ordinary sub calls and invalid invocant counts on methods. This diagnostic covers restricted shape value-producing calls.
S_dispatch_pattern_validate rejects OP_REGCOMP inside the shape. Dynamic regex evaluation belongs in the guard, outside the inert shape expression.
Non-predicate entersub shapes require a callable target and the supported sub/method arity. Validation rejects other call representations.
Both validation and matching require the NumEq criterion operand to be OP_CONST or OP_UNDEF. The separate 0+ coercion path also supports pins.
The object criterion requires a list containing the class and a following shape operand before recursively validating the shape.
Array validation rejects more than two ellipses and the two-ellipsis case with fewer than three logical children.
The array-shape child scan counts more than one slurp.
An array ellipsis has a logical child index other than first or last.
Array slurp is not the final logical element or any ellipsis also occurs.
Hash shapes permit at most one ellipsis; the first pass counts logical special children.
Hash shapes permit at most one hash slurp.
After excluding slurps and ellipses the hash child count is odd, leaving an unmatched key.
The hash ellipsis is not its final logical child.
The hash slurp is not final or is combined with an ellipsis.
Within the parser shape context a key must be a constant, pin or non-predicate value-producing call; other expression forms are rejected.
The explicit shape-op whitelist rejects ordinary Perl expression operators after the special assignment, call, numeric, concat and container handlers.
At matching time the retained ordinary sub-call target cannot be resolved to a CV. A previously valid glob can lose its sub, so this is not solely declaration grammar.
The shape call executor requires a constant invocant and OP_METHOD_NAMED for a value-producing method call. Other dynamic forms are unsupported.
The numeric-coercion node must resolve to a constant, undef or scalar pin before numerical matching. Missing or malformed operands cannot be used as a shape criterion.
pp_dispatch_on requires non-null auxiliary data, the expected aux magic and a root compiled pattern. Missing compiler output is an internal opcode contract.

Pthread mutex, condition, join/detach and interpreter-context APIs share a return-code-and-C-location contract. Their operation variants span several subjects, so keep the shared diagnostic at Threads rather than misclassifying it as only a mutex failure. Preserve destruction-time suppression and errno handling.
The Mach cthreads MUTEX_INIT adapter cannot allocate its mutex object. It reports the C file and line; pthread return-code failures use the shared API diagnostic.
The Mach cthreads COND_INIT adapter cannot allocate a condition object. Preserve the file/line form, distinct from APIs that return an error code.
scan_const rejects variable interpolation only while in_dispatch_pattern_dquote is set. The shape string must not evaluate interpolated ordinary Perl variables.
S_pending_ident finds an existing clause-local binding in dispatch_pattern_vars before adding a new scalar/array/hash capture. Pins bypass declarations and this check.

The DEBUGGING safesysmalloc guard rejects a negative SSize_t conversion after optional memory-debug-header adjustment. Real malloc exhaustion keeps its separate handling.

my_fork has no available fork implementation after HAS_FORK and Amiga alternatives. The source calls this an unexpected caller path, but it remains a capability failure rather than inventing panic metadata.
my_vsnprintf cannot process va_list arguments under USE_QUADMATH because there is no quadmath_vsnprintf implementation; preserve its no-context delivery.
Perl_my_vsnprintf rejects a negative formatting result or a result that would not fit its output buffer.

rationale: Perl_xs_handshake compares the extension API version with the interpreter API. Both before-initialization and normal package-name producers share this contract.

review_status: applied; all remaining Load producers and neighboring embedding/OS2 invariants reviewed
rationale: HS_KEYp requires API and XS version string lengths to fit their packed handshake fields. Overflow is an internal encoding invariant, unlike compatibility rejection of another binary.
upg_version cannot find the decimal radix in its formatted NV version and has no locale-switch fallback compiled. Keep the existing locale-aware branches unchanged.
upg_version cannot classify the supplied value as an integer, float, v-string or PV. Preserve old-version compatibility branches and distinguish parser format errors.
Version numify, normalize, stringify and comparison require VVERIFY to validate the object shape. This is not merely invalid text syntax.
The FreeMiNT DynaLoader rejects the global-symbol flag bit before linking a file. This is a loader visibility capability, not a symbol lookup miss or a universal platform failure.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: Both debug_printf and ktrace_printf require at least a format argument before sprintf formatting. Retain the shared diagnostic despite its debug_printf-only usage text.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: The Haiku debugger entry requires a format argument before building the native debugger text. Keep the separate debugger action.
croak_with_os2error shares a caller-supplied operation description and os2error(Perl_rc) across PM, module and process operations. Retain the genuine platform-wide API adapter.
OS2 pthread_join rejects a thread ordinal outside its table except the explicit pthread_not_existant sentinel, which instead warns and returns successfully. Preserve the sentinel exception.
The OS/2 pthread emulation rejects join in the waited state after releasing its mutex. It is a platform lifecycle contract, not a generic threads module diagnostic.
OS2 pthread_join finds pthreads_st_norun, meaning startup detected an ID still in use. It saves the old state for reporting, resets the slot and unlocks before throwing.
OS2 pthread_join reaches an unrecognized join-table state after its valid exited, waited, norun and running cases. It releases the table mutex before throwing.
OS2 pthread_startit completes a thread but finds a table state other than waited, detached or running. This is the exit-state invariant, not thread creation failure.
OS2 pthread_detach rejects an ordinal outside its table except pthread_not_existant, which is a separate warning-and-return case.
The OS/2 pthread emulation rejects detach in the waited state after releasing its mutex. Keep it distinct from detached/reused/unstarted states.
OS2 pthread_detach finds the startup ID-reuse failure state, copies its original status for display and releases/reset the table slot before throwing.
OS2 pthread_detach reaches an unrecognized table state after its valid waited, running, exited, detached and norun cases. Preserve the separately categorized warnings.

review_status: applied; all remaining Load producers and neighboring embedding/OS2 invariants reviewed
rationale: OS/2 loadModule reports dlopen failure only when its fail argument requests an exception. The module is a native DLL, not a Perl require target.
The EMX my_type_set implementation rejects DOS-mode execution before querying process information blocks. The type is the process application mode, not Perl scalar type.

review_status: applied; all remaining Load producers and neighboring embedding/OS2 invariants reviewed
rationale: OS/2 loadByOrdinal checks that its static loadOrdinals array matches ORD_NENTRIES before indexing it. This is an implementation-table invariant, not module lookup failure.
Loading a requires_pm DLL in a non-PM mode needs PERL_ASIF_PM or a detectable PM mutex. This is a module prerequisite, not a missing entry point.
A loaded DLL lacks the requested named/ordinal entry point and fail is set. Optional queries return zero instead.
loadByOrdinal still has the unresolved -1 function sentinel after its lookup path. Keep this internal cache invariant distinct from a missing OS entry point.
get_sysinfo receives process data for a PID different from the requested nonzero PID. Free the result before reporting this internal result mismatch.
The EMX file_type helper requires OS/2 before DosQueryAppType. Its subject is executable application type, not a generic filesystem stat error.
sys_alloc returns -1 for ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY, but other DosAllocMem errors use this diagnostic. This is explicitly not the ordinary out-of-memory path.
OS2 mod2fname requires a reference before dereferencing the module-name component collection.
OS2 mod2fname requires an ARRAY referent for its module-name component collection.
OS2 mod2fname rejects an empty component array before computing the mangled DLL base name.
dir_subst cannot fit INSTALL_PREFIX including its terminator in the destination under fatal mode. Nonfatal calls return NULL.
dir_subst needs to strip the EXE/DLL filename but cannot find its directory slash. Only fatal substitution mode throws.
dir_subst processes another /.. segment but cannot find a parent slash to remove. Preserve its fatal/nonfatal split.
dir_subst cannot fit substituted path bytes plus the terminator in its destination. Fatal mode throws; other modes return NULL. Keep recursive path-tail handling unchanged.
Both perllib_mangle variants reject replacement prefix or resulting path lengths beyond STATIC_FILE_LENGTH. The old malformed label concealed a bounds check.
The versioned or unversioned PERLLIB_*_PREFIX parser requires nonempty old and replacement components. Keep the actual environment-variable name parameter.
Both serving and processing PM messages require a positive message-queue reference count unless an existing server handles the request.
The PM message loops encounter WM_QUIT or GetMsg termination. Preserve the deliberate throw for loop termination rather than pretending it is an OS errno failure.
OS2::Error cannot apply the requested hard-error/exception policy with DosError. Keep the flags and native error description.
Errors2Drive accepts undef to disable suppression; a defined value must begin with an alphabetic drive letter. The producer does not enforce one-character string length.
DosSuppressPopUps fails after drive validation. Preserve this API failure separately from invalid drive input.

review_status: applied; all ordinary Numeric producers reviewed and misplaced members redistributed
rationale: XS_OS2_Process_Messages requires its optional in/out count SV to have IOK storage after SvIV conversion, then passes a signed I32 count to the native message loop and stores the updated count. It is an OS2 event-loop API contract.
extLibpath reports success but leaves the sentinel bytes untouched. The producer calls this a panic even though its historical name blames a parameter. Preserve the actual output invariant.
OS2 mutex operations and condition initialization report a native return code through one operation-variant diagnostic. Keep its mixed mutex/condition scope and existing platform API calls.
OS2 COND_SIGNAL treats a failing DosPostEventSem result as an error except OS2_ERROR_ALREADY_POSTED, which is accepted. Preserve this allowed status.
OS2 condition broadcast and destruction share a return-code diagnostic. Broadcast accepts already-posted status; destruction checks DosCloseEventSem. Preserve both fixed operation variants.
The EMX pthread_key_create macro cannot allocate one thread-local memory slot. Keep its allocation-free literal diagnostic and return status path.
_ckvmssts rejects a native status with the low success bit clear and preserves errno/VMS status. Its early noperl alias uses fprintf/lib$signal rather than the exception API.
Windows pseudo-fork initializes thread locales, then restores the parent locale through Perl_setlocale. Failure to restore is a locale-switch invariant, not failure to create the child process.

win32_croak_not_implemented is used by networking database stubs and the non-ithreads fork host adapter. Keep its shared platform subject and newline behavior rather than misclassifying all callers as networking.

review_status: applied; IO Handle group producers and neighboring operations reviewed
rationale: win32_ioctl reports ENOTSOCK from ioctlsocket; a Windows IO-control capability restriction, not general handle resolution.
Windows mutex/join/detach and the OS2 condition-wait adapter use a shared operation-only failure template. This contract has no recorded status or C location and must not claim those fields exist.
Windows condition initialization, signaling, broadcast, wait and destruction report GetLastError through their shared template. Preserve waiters checks and the operation variants.
The public MEM_WRAP_CHECK_s compatibility macro accepts a caller-owned literal format. It cannot be assigned one semantic message identity; preserve its literal-only format contract.
sv_dup_common cannot map a source SV type to a supported cloned body. It throws using the prototype interpreter context; preserve that explicit context and threaded-only producer.

All callers guard absent OS functions: filesystem, ownership, IPC pipes, process control, priority, signals and passwd/group enumeration. Preserve CROAK_NOCONTEXT, DIE and DIE_NOCONTEXT aliases and the audited keyword adapter. A syscall family reflects this genuinely shared producer contract.

review_status: applied; all eight ordinary Memory producers reviewed
rationale: Perl_av_extend_guts and pp_aelem invoke PERL_MEM_WRAP_CHECK_DIAG for an SV-pointer array size that exceeds the representable byte count. The check is conditional on PERL_MALLOC_WRAP.
The constant builtin checker does not recognize the descriptor ckval. This is a registry/compiler invariant, separate from runtime opcode dispatch and user values.
The DEBUGGING pp_freed sentinel is executed after an opcode has been freed. Retain the pointer parameter and DEBUGGING-only producer.

ck_require rejects a bareword module name beginning with double colon before converting package separators to path separators. The adjacent old comment does not describe the current rejecting behavior.
ck_require rejects an empty constant bareword name before normalization or adding the .pm suffix.
prototype with a CORE:: name requires a recognized Perl keyword; this is name resolution, not numeric arithmetic.
pp_crypt reports the missing HAS_CRYPT capability through DIE. It does not report authentication failure or claim that crypt implements modern encryption.

Both local and ordinary delete paths see an AV where hash-form deletion was requested, without the SPECIAL flag that permits array deletion. Preserve the valid array form and do not remove the malformed-optree guard.
pp_split exceeds its safety bound derived from input length and split limits. This guards engine progress and is distinct from user regex recursion.

Socket operations and host/network/protocol/service database get/set/end operations share PL_no_sock_func. All producers are capability guards, including the socket-op branch of unimplemented_op. Preserve the audited keyword OP_DESC adapter and do not classify passwd/group database calls as sockets.

unimplemented_op reports an op with no implementation after separately handling unsupported socket functions. It uses PL_op_name or an explicit out-of-range label rather than custom-op metadata lookup.
pp_coreargs enforces OA_AVREF for explicit runtime CORE:: arguments. The no-argument default-array behavior is a separate accepted path.
pp_coreargs enforces OA_HVREF. dbmopen/dbmclose require a hash; other supported coreargs operations also accept an array. The existing accepted_reference_types selector preserves that distinction.
OA_SCALARREF in pp_coreargs selects a scalar-only, code-inclusive or code-exclusive reference set from the opcode/private flags and rejects values outside it.

pp_coreargs dispatches the argument-class nibbles from PL_opargs while binding a CORE:: call. An unknown OA class is internal calling-convention metadata, not a user object class or ordinary invalid argument.
pp_subst and pp_substcont exceed their input-length-derived iteration bound. Both literal and evaluated replacement paths retain the same guard and DIE delivery.
pp_dbstate requires an executable DB::DB hook when stepping, tracing or a breakpoint activates it.
pp_return dispatches eval, sub and format frames to the corresponding leave operation. A different target context is an internal return/unwind invariant.
goto &sub cannot resolve a named target, or a destructor removes its body during unwind.
goto &sub has an unnamed target without an executable body, including extension-created CVs.
goto &sub needs a current subroutine frame to replace.
The current frame is a string eval rather than a replaceable subroutine frame.
The current frame is a block eval rather than a replaceable subroutine frame.
A multicall callback frame, such as sort, cannot be replaced by goto &sub.
A label jump would leave a format, pseudo block or multicall callback boundary.
Goto label search reaches an unsupported frame at a nonzero context index. At index zero the same default validly searches the main optree. Preserve both cases.
The goto/dump label search finishes without a matching label.
pp_goto is about to pop unwanted frames but its chosen unwind index is negative. The historical docatch name does not describe the actual producer.

rationale: Both Perl and XSUB branches of pp_entersub reject required lvalue invocation when CvLVALUE is false. This is the runtime counterpart of the known-callee compile check.
sort cannot resolve an executable named comparison subroutine after autoload handling.
sort has an undefined comparison subroutine without a resolvable named fallback.
write resolves its output handle to a format GV that lacks a report body.
Report pagination selects the top/header GV, but the format body is no longer defined.

review_status: applied; all ordinary Numeric producers reviewed and misplaced members redistributed
rationale: The shared pp_ioctl/fcntl implementation checks whether a sentinel beyond its string argument changed during the system call. This detects an external-call argument-buffer overrun, not numeric overflow or necessarily an internal Perl defect.
The effective-ID file-test access path is selected in a build without PERL_EFF_ACCESS. This is an unsupported internal dispatch state, not an access() errno failure.
The real-ID file-test access path is selected in a build without HAS_ACCESS. Keep it distinct from the effective-ID capability and preserve the operation name.

review_status: applied; IO Handle group producers and neighboring operations reviewed
rationale: pp_fttext rejects -T/-B on an IO stream without the base buffering capability required to inspect its contents.
All six directory entry points report unavailable read/seek/tell/rewind/close primitives under their own compile guards. Preserve operation names and the separate return-undef OS failure paths.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: The POSIX getpgrp path accepts an omitted/zero pid or the current pid only. This is not a syntactic no-arguments rule, and BSD getpgrp supports other pids.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: The POSIX setpgrp path allows only zero/current pid for both supplied pid and pgrp. BSD variants accept broader IDs. Preserve this platform contract and existing code.
The shared semget/msgget/shmget entry reports absence of all System V IPC capabilities. Operation-specific helper guards use a separate diagnostic when only some capabilities exist.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: The syscall dispatcher supports one through fifteen total arguments including the syscall number. The default switch arm rejects larger lists after taint handling.

related_python_categories: contract comparison only; subject family follows producer evidence
rationale: A zero-item syscall list lacks its syscall number. It shares the dispatcher with the separate upper-bound check.
av_reify in DEBUGGING detects tied magic on a non-real array before reifying its elements.
av_clear in DEBUGGING finds a zero-reference-count array before the normal clear operation.
builtin warning helpers report calls or imports marked experimental by the builtin descriptor, and the explicitly experimental lexical-export API.

scalarvoid marks unused value-producing operations in void context and builtin::indexed directly reports void use. The PV and SV producer forms retain separate identities and opcode/literal selectors.
scalar warns for sort used in scalar context, and builtin::indexed warns while returning its scalar count. This is context misuse, not a generic container failure.

pp_initfield warns when the stacked hash-field initializer has an odd SV count before supplying undef for the missing value. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

do_open6 rejects reference-backed explicit opens in USE_STDIO builds unless the mode is descriptor duplication. It sets EINVAL and takes the failure cleanup path. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

Both write-pipe and read-pipe open paths reject an empty command after parsing mode/whitespace, set EPIPE and return through failure cleanup. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

The legacy write-pipe path strips a trailing pipe marker and warns before continuing with its one-way pipe implementation. Do not describe this as a failed OS pipe syscall. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
Open, stat, lstat and text-file tests fail on a path accepted by should_warn_nl. The warning reports a suspicious filename, not an encoding failure.
openn_cleanup warns when a read-only stream reuses either stdout or stderr, identifying OUT or ERR and the target glob. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
openn_cleanup warns when a write-only stream reuses stdin. The shared WARN_IO guard is preserved. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

nextargv rejects fork-style magic opens encountered by diamond input, even on its non-inplace path. Honor the historical WARN_INPLACE category rather than inferring a new pipe category. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

nextargv detects a non-regular input on both successful-open and failed-open/stat paths. Preserve checked and unchecked warning variants and skip the file. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

Without FLEXFILENAMES, the generated backup path resolves to the input device/inode. Reject that alias before creating replacement output. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

openindirtemp can fail at mkstemp, fdopen or attaching the temporary stream to the output glob. The warning concerns temporary output creation, not just generating a filename. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

nextargv preserves errno from the failed input open and uses this form when a subsequent stat does not identify a non-regular file. Preserve the caller WARN_INPLACE guard. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
io_close reports a requested close failure using the glob name when a GV exists; prior stream errors can contribute to retval. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

io_close uses this form for the same requested close failure when no GV name is available. Keep its smaller parameter contract. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
Printing to a byte handle or setting an environment key/value or process name cannot downgrade the supplied string; preserve the operation selector and existing encoding behavior.

my_lstat_flags warns for -l applied to a glob handle, both direct-reference and checked stack paths. Preserve the unchecked alias under the existing WARN_IO guard. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
my_lstat_flags uses this form when the supplied reference is a bare IO object rather than a named glob. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
exec_failed reports the failed program and saved errno text, then optionally sends errno over the parent reporting pipe. The Amiga producer additionally checks nonzero errno.
start_glob has no stream after attempting to launch the external glob helper. Preserve the existing platform-specific launch paths. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
do_vecget and do_vecset warn on the supported 64-bit vector field under UV_IS_QUAD; narrower platforms cannot support that width. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The shared alien-digit formatter collects WARN_DIGIT details for octal/hex escapes under explicit digit-warning guards. Preserve the resolved spelling, radix selectors, parser context and regex-specific alternative identity. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
runops_debug is entered with a null PL_op and returns after issuing the debugging warning.
gv_fetchmeth_internal cannot find an ancestor stash during overload or DESTROY lookup. AUTOLOAD is deliberately excluded from this warning. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

The same method lookup warns for an unavailable ancestor stash on ordinary method resolution, preserving method/class data and the suggested load name. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

S_find_default_stash warns when strict-vars lookup finds an unimported scalar, array or hash slot. This warning precedes the strict-variable failure. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

S_find_default_stash emits this separate warning only if the unimported glob also has a CV. Preserve its separate warning delivery, not a new nested Note conversion. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
gv_fetchpvn_flags reaches new-glob initialization with GV_ADDWARN requested. The flag requests reporting symbol creation; it does not alone prove memory corruption.
gv_check emits once-controlled warnings for a package symbol marked as used once, with separate fatal-warning delivery when GvONCE_FATAL is set.
The keyword scanner recognizes the common elseif misspelling, warns and returns through the unknown-keyword path. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
new_ctype encounters an unsupported non-UTF-8 multibyte LC_CTYPE locale and accumulates a locale warning for immediate or deferred delivery.
setlocale cannot map the requested category, reports whether a locale argument was supplied, sets EINVAL and returns null.
mfree rejects a bad allocator magic value and RCHECK identifies the freed-block marker, under existing PERL_BADFREE and interpreter-lifetime gates.
mfree rejects a bad allocator magic value not handled as the RCHECK duplicate-free marker, preserving existing reporting gates.
Perl_realloc rejects bad allocator magic and RCHECK identifies the freed-block marker, under existing reporting gates.
Perl_realloc rejects bad allocator magic not handled as the RCHECK freed-block marker, preserving the existing null return.
magic_setsig cannot resolve a supplied SIG key to a positive signal number and reports its escaped spelling.

magic_setarylen warns when arylen magic no longer has an array object. It uses WARN_MISC despite the lifetime/invariant subject. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

Substring reads and magic-backed substring fetches warn and return undef when offset translation fails. Replacement bound failures remain separate errors. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

Substring assignment, optimized left-substr mutation and substring magic warn before coercing a reference target to a string. This concerns the mutated target, not the substring result type. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
perly_sighandler resolves no executable CV/root for a named handler and reports the signal and available HEK name.
perly_sighandler resolves no executable CV/root and has no handler HEK name, retaining the separate anonymous wording.

output_non_portable reports a binary, octal or hexadecimal value outside 32 bits; decimal input deliberately does not warn. Preserve the current English base-description payload for separate localization follow-up. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

grok_uint_by_base warns for disallowed binary/hex digits or the octal digits eight/nine, unless silent scanning is requested. Other non-octal terminators are excluded. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The base scanner and tokenizer report an overflow while accumulating nondecimal integer values. Preserve ordinary and default-enabled delivery variants and fallback accumulation behavior. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

scalarboolean warns for a scalar assignment with a constant RHS, directly or beneath logical not, excluding the special flag. Preserve the conditional first-line location. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
scalarvoid reports unused value-producing operations whose detail text is built in an SV, with the existing opcode selector and formatting retained.
check_or_warn_refaliasing emits the experiment warning only after the feature-disabled fatal guard permits reference aliasing.
declaration checking and my lexing report reference declaration syntax after enforcing the declared_refs feature gate.

op_lvalue_flags has classified the expression as localize=-1 and reports useless local. Keep audited opcode selectors and literal/custom fallback descriptions. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

move_proto_attr warns when a later prototype attribute replaces an earlier one in the same declaration. Preserve the explicit WARN_MISC guard. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
move_proto_attr replaces the declared prototype with the prototype attribute and reports both values.

bind_match warns before applying match, substitution or transliteration to an aggregate in scalar context. This form has a discovered variable name. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

bind_match emits the same aggregate-scalarization warning using a sample array/hash spelling when no variable name is available. Preserve its separate parameter contract. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
bind_match, comparison checking, isa and implements detect unparenthesized logical negation at the left of a tighter-binding operation, retaining comparison/double-negation exemptions.
is_control_transfer warns for unparenthesized non-folded dump/next/last/redo/exit/return/die/goto used in a low-precedence logical construction. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
localize scans an unparenthesized comma-separated my/our/state/local list ending in semicolon or assignment, with existing open/opendir/socket/accept exemptions.

pmtrans warns when deletion is requested but the nonempty replacement list covers the search list without deleting entries. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
pmtrans compares expanded replacement and search counts and warns when the replacement list is longer. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
new_logop finds a bareword constant in a logical condition after excluding the strict-bareword error path.

new_logop warns about a truth-tested readline, readdir, glob or each result that can be the defined string 0. Preserve the bounded operation selector and first-line location. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
cv_ckproto_len_flags compares the existing and proposed prototype, including absent prototypes. This is a declaration mismatch, not an internal corruption invariant.

already_defined warns when an existing pure-Perl body cannot acquire a subsequently supplied lvalue attribute. Preserve compcv protection across fatal warnings. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
newATTRSUB_x discards a supplied prototype after executing the BEGIN body. This is phase processing, not callable binding. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
The same completed-BEGIN path discards supplied attributes; preserve the separate identity and message. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
newATTRSUB_x and report_redefined_cv report replacement of an existing constant CV under their existing redefine/value-comparison gates.
process_special_blocks encounters CHECK after PL_main_start is set and still queues the block. The warning remains controlled by WARN_VOID.
process_special_blocks encounters INIT after PL_main_start and cannot queue it for startup execution. The existing Module::Install workaround and WARN_VOID control remain.
newFORM replaces the existing GvFORM for an explicitly named report format. This is not a subroutine prototype or printf format.
newFORM replaces the default STDOUT report format when no explicit format name op was supplied.
oopsAV receives an op outside its supported pad-scalar/pad-hash and scalar/hash-dereference conversion cases.
oopsHV receives an op outside its supported pad-scalar/pad-array and scalar/array-dereference conversion cases.
ck_bitop finds an unparenthesized numeric comparison as an operand of a non-assignment infix bitwise operator, including numeric and string bitwise forms.

ck_cmp sees the dollar-bracket array-base variable and a constant in a comparison other than ordinary eq/ne. The hint suspects a version check but does not prove that intent. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

ck_ftst warns for an array operand when it can derive a named element suggestion. The checker serves file-test operations, despite the historical stat wording. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
ck_ftst cannot derive a name for the array file-test operand and emits the shorter coercion warning before scalarizing it. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

ck_fun warns only for push or unshift with no sibling values after the array operand. This is a useless array insertion, not arbitrary empty-argument calls. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

simplify_sort finds lexical my/state a or b in a comparison where package sort variables are expected. Preserve the actual pad-name and declaration-kind payload. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
ck_split finds PMf_GLOBAL on the pattern being converted to split. Split already chooses its own repeated matching; /g has no effect.
ck_join sees a match operation as the separator and suggests quoting its pattern as a string. Preserve its independent WARN_SYNTAX delivery. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

ck_each detects an anonymous hash returned from the aggregate scope/block and warns that each will start anew. This is iterator lifetime, not numeric recursion. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
ck_each detects the analogous anonymous-array aggregate and preserves its distinct message before converting the operation to array each. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

ck_length can recover an array/hash name and suggests scalar array count or scalar keys count. Keep array/hash selector wording and existing coercion. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
ck_length has an unnamed hash operand and uses the sample-hash suggestion. This is not a numeric length-range failure. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
ck_length has an unnamed array operand and uses the sample-array suggestion. Preserve its separate parameterless template. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
subsignature_append_named warns for the first named parameter in a signature, before separate slurpy/order validation.
pad_check_dup finds a same-name lexical declaration in the same statement or scope, excluding our/our and fields from different classes.
pad_check_dup finds the same our variable in the same stash and declaration-introduction range.

pad_check_dup follows an our redeclaration warning with this independently emitted WARN_SHADOW suggestion when the earlier binding is at or below the name floor. Preserve its independent warning delivery.
pad_findlex and cv_clone_pad cannot capture an outer lexical from an uninstantiated anonymous prototype, stale pad or inactive parent. The selector distinguishes variables and lexical subroutines.
pad_findlex reports a non-state lexical captured through a multiply instantiated outer binding while compiling the inner CV and suppresses repeated reports during the recursive lookup.
pad_leavemy still has pending named non-outer lexical introductions after leaving the pad name range.
peephole checks find implicit @_ use through argumentless shift/pop, non-stacked entersub or goto-sub forms in the enclosing signatured CV, looking through eval CVs.
optimize_op sees an array access backed by PL_defgv in the enclosing signatured CV and uses the effective parent operation for the selector.
finalize_op finds a following statement after exec that is not exit, warn or die and reports at that statement line.
finalize_op emits this independent WARN_EXEC suggestion after the unlikely-reached warning. Preserve the separate warning and hook call.
finalize_op sees an early-call GV whose CV now has a prototype, after the call was compiled without checking it.
perl_destruct at level two or above finds a nonzero scope-stack index. Signed direction and magnitude remain separate without unsigned-casting a negative count.
perl_destruct at level two or above finds a nonzero save-stack index, retaining signed direction and safe magnitude.
perl_destruct at level two or above finds the temporary stack floor is not minus one and reports its signed offset plus one.
perl_destruct at level two or above finds the context-stack index is not minus one. This is an independent internal warning, not a supplementary hint.
perl_destruct still finds entries in the shared string table and reports each stored reference count while freeing the entries.
perl_destruct finds a nonzero PL_sv_count after scalar cleanup. The diagnostic reports an allocation counter, not a trustworthy unsigned leak count.
parse_body sees inherited SIGCHLD/SIGCLD ignored and resets it to default after warning.

get_debug_opts warns for an unknown word-character -D flag. The current catalog uses CK_WARNER_D and WARN_DEBUGGING, whose category ancestry is Warning::Severe::Debugging. Preserve the non-word and numeric option paths.

The non-DEBUGGING -D option path uses catalog CK_WARNER_D with WARN_DEBUGGING. The warning hierarchy places debugging under severe. An older review description calling this uncategorized is stale. Preserve current delivery and source guards.
init_argv_symbols warns when -i is active but the argument array is absent or empty; execution reads standard input instead. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

PerlIO_parse_layers requires an identifier start after layer separators; otherwise it reports the actual character, sets EINVAL and returns failure. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

PerlIO_parse_layers reaches the end while scanning a layer argument list, including escaped-end handling. This is layer syntax, not callable signature binding. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
PerlIO_parse_layers cannot resolve the parsed layer name and returns failure after warning. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.

PerlIOScalar_pushed rejects a read-only non-COW target when a non-read mode is requested, with EACCES. Read-only read mode remains valid. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
PerlIOScalar_seek computes a negative target position and returns EINVAL. Positive seeks beyond the string end are not this failure. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
pp_bless warns when an explicit class argument stringifies to an empty name. WARN_MISC controls this diagnostic, regardless of its object-blessing subject.

pp_undef warns before undefining a CV whose cv_const_sv is non-null. This is a deliberate subroutine mutation, not an uninitialized-value use. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
pp_repeat treats NaN or an infinite repeat count as zero and emits WARN_NUMERIC before either list or string repetition.
pp_repeat normalizes a negative repeat count to zero and emits WARN_NUMERIC for both list and string repetition.
The RNG seed adapter warns before using an address-derived string for a reference without string overloading. Its WARN_MISC policy differs from the related numeric seed overflow warning.
The drand48 seed adapter warns when decimal seed conversion overflows before conversion to U32. WARN_OVERFLOW controls this diagnostic; RNG::Seed subject tags remain.
chr sees a negative signed/numeric value outside byte semantics and substitutes the Unicode replacement character after warning.
pp_anonhash warns when the final key has no paired value, then supplies undef. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

pp_splice warns only with an explicit length argument when offset exceeds the insertion position after the final array element. It clamps the offset afterward. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

formline consumes a picture field after the argument stack is exhausted, substitutes an empty scalar and warns. This concerns Perl report formats, not printf. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.
dopoptolabel and dopoptoloop cross substitution, subroutine, report-format or sort contexts while searching for a transfer target, with try-context exemptions.

Parser deferral and die_unwind emit this independent warning for EVAL_KEEPERR cleanup failures. Preserve the wrapped error text and existing warning/hook behavior. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
require_file fails do lookup with no dot entry in INC, but can stat and open the named local file; it recommends an explicit relative path under the existing platform/category guards.
Regex preparation detects a name already seen in a different regexp in the same clause. Only the first regexp publishes the lexical capture; existing warning category policy is preserved.
The dispatch lookup-table builder finds an already-seen simple constant and reports both original and duplicate source locations. The later clause cannot match.

padsv_store, sassign and aassign warn for unshared temporary targets without set magic, excluding genuine globs. Preserve all existing WARN_MISC guards. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

do_readline clears pre-existing stream errors before closing the glob child; a failing close reports the child status and optional core-dump selector. Keep the controlling warning category and all delivery variants.
do_readline validates the newly read UTF-8 region and reports the first invalid byte. The old code implied only a non-Unicode code point, but the predicate checks malformed encoding.

multideref and aelem warn when an array index is a reference without get/overload magic. Preserve the checked and unchecked emitter variants. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
sub_crush_depth reports the deep-call threshold for an anonymous CV. It does not establish lack of computational progress.
sub_crush_depth reports the deep-call threshold for a named CV and includes cv_name. It does not establish infinite recursion.

utf8_to_byte decodes a character for byte-oriented unpack and warns before narrowing a value at least 256 to U8. Invalid encoding has its separate error. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

pack/unpack UTF-8-to-byte conversion records values above the byte range, preserves the converted bytes, then appends its pack/unpack-controlled warning after collected encoding warnings. Use the generic catalog Warning class so construction derives the actual runtime category class or common ancestor instead of overriding it with a fixed subject class.

The common pack/unpack symbol scanner permits commas with one WARN_UNPACK warning per scan. The category is historical and applies to both actions. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
The shared pack/unpack scanner reports a modifier already set on the current code. Conflicting byte-order modifiers remain separate errors. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
The c directive warns when its IV argument is outside -128..127 and then emits its narrowed byte value. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
The C directive warns when its IV argument is outside 0..255 and then emits its narrowed byte value. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The byte-output W path sees a value at least 256 but cannot take its ordinary unmarked-output upgrade path, so it warns and narrows to U8. Preserve byte/UTF-8 mode transitions. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

Pointer packing warns for a temporary or insufficiently retained target before obtaining its address. Preserve the reference-counted-stack-dependent threshold and PADTMP exemption for read-only values. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The u directive rounds the requested line width to a multiple of three, warns at 64 or more and clamps to 63. This is uuencode formatting, not an object field. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
untie finds references beyond its own tie object reference and no UNTIE callback to handle them, then continues removing magic.
pp_sselect warns before coercing a defined, mutable non-string bitmask. WARN_MISC controls this diagnostic; IO::Select is subject information, not its warning-control ancestry.

leavewrite subtracts the report body line count from remaining page lines and warns if the signed result is negative. This concerns report pagination, not arithmetic overflow. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

recvfrom, accept and socket-name lookup paths warn when the returned address length exceeds the supplied buffer, then clamp it to capacity. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

pp_stat reports lstat on an actual handle, retaining named/anonymous selector cases and the special cached-stat handling for the default handle. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
The filehandle form of chdir cannot resolve the supplied handle, warns under WARN_UNOPENED, sets EBADF and returns false. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

warn_not_dirhandle chooses this form when the handle has an input stream but is not the requested directory handle. The operation is an audited literal directory function name. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

warn_not_dirhandle chooses this form when the failed directory operation has no input stream. Preserve its distinction from a real open filehandle. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.

gmtime/localtime conversion warns when floored NV input is NaN or cannot round-trip through Time64_T, or exceeds TIME_UPPER_BOUND. The shared diagnostic is broader than an unsigned large-count check. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The time conversion helper rejects values below TIME_LOWER_BOUND and then follows its failed-conversion path. Preserve the signed lower-bound test. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

gmtime/localtime reports failure when conversion returns NULL, including earlier invalid/range paths. Preserve this historical category and possible preceding range diagnostic. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

pp_alarm rejects a negative signed argument with WARN_MISC, EINVAL and undef. It is not a general argument-binding failure. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
pp_sleep warns for a negative signed duration, sets EINVAL and returns zero. Preserve the no-argument pause path. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
parse_uniprop_string recognizes a delimited Unicode property wildcard expression after its termination checks.
parse_uniprop_string decodes a deprecated Unicode property index and selects its known reason or external message fallback before continuing property resolution.
parse_uniprop_string merges a hints-provided private-use override into the property after validation, taint rejection and restriction to private-use code points.
study_chunk detects a zero-width quantified subpattern under its eval, group and bounded-count guards. Preserve this study-level warning separately from the regpiece early empty-match warning.
reginclass matches a super-Unicode code point against an ANYOF Unicode property with its warning flag, excluding ANYOFD.
S_not_a_number displays a bounded escaped representation of the nonnumeric value and emits WARN_NUMERIC with the current operation selector and description when PL_op is available.
S_not_a_number emits WARN_NUMERIC without operation context when PL_op is absent. Keep this identity separate from the operation-aware form.
S_not_incrementable emits WARN_NUMERIC for increment input that does not meet its numeric or permitted string-increment contract. The displayed input is escaped and bounded by sv_display.

sv_setsv_flags and sv_set_undef warn when asked to assign an undefined value to a genuine typeglob. The category is WARN_MISC rather than WARN_UNINITIALIZED. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
newSVsv_flags_NN finds SVt_LAST on the source in the non-mortal-copy path and discards the destination before returning null.
sv_rvweaken accepts undef silently, rejects nonreferences as errors, and warns under WARN_MISC when a reference is already weak. The control-group class is Misc; reference semantics remain in tags.

sv_rvunweaken accepts undef silently, rejects nonreferences as errors, and warns under WARN_MISC for a reference that is not weak. Keep this identity distinct from weaken and preserve the early return.

Perl_sv_inc_nomg warns under WARN_IMPRECISION when a finite NV reaches the precision boundary where adding one cannot be represented reliably. Preserve its asymmetric positive and negative threshold predicates.
Perl_sv_dec_nomg warns under WARN_IMPRECISION at the corresponding finite NV decrement precision boundary. Preserve the distinct increment and decrement predicates and identities.
sv_vcatpvfn_flags records a missing value or conversion operand and calls its warning helper. The active opcode identifies formatter context, not a generic callable arity contract.
sv_vcatpvfn_flags sees an unsupported width on its internal pointer conversion syntax after recognized extension cases, warning about future printf conflicts.

The printf vector path rejects version objects marked alpha, substitutes an empty value and continues. This is printf conversion support, not general callable arity. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

The printf parser reports an invalid conversion or end-of-format through the existing operation and conversion-state data, then emits the percent and resumes scanning. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
sv_vcatpvfn_flags has unused supplied format arguments after conversions and suppresses this check when explicit positional references make argument consumption unreliable.

Perl_report_uninit emits this WARN_UNINITIALIZED diagnostic when an operation description is available. Variable discovery independently selects named or unnamed wording. Operation and variable-name selectors affect rendering, not the controlling warning category. The XS API fixture only exercises collector ownership.

Perl_report_uninit emits this WARN_UNINITIALIZED diagnostic when no operation description can be established. It reports the same undefined-value contract without inventing operation or variable context.
validate_proto encounters a non-space character after an unescaped @ or % outside a bracket group. The old code incorrectly described attributes.
validate_proto finishes with an open bracket group in the prototype.
validate_proto finds a byte outside the allowed prototype grammar, including a NUL. Unicode display escaping does not make this an encoding failure.
validate_proto finds a non-space character other than semicolon, @ or % immediately after the underscore prototype slot.
check_unary detects a nearby unary operator token without an intervening opening parenthesis under its existing parsing heuristics.
scan_const in a pattern sees dollar followed by backslash and appends a warning to the pending exception before leaving interpolation scanning.

scan_const recognizes a single nonzero backslash digit in a non-pattern substitution replacement, warns and rewrites its backslash to a dollar sign. Preserve parser accumulation. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

scan_const collects a warning for an unrecognized alphanumeric escape and then copies the quoted character. Preserve accumulation and passthrough behavior. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.

The dollar-token scanner finds comma-based multidimensional syntax inside an array subscript and warns without changing its existing scan behavior. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

The dollar-token scanner examines a SIG hash assignment followed by an existing subroutine bareword and semicolon; it suggests quoting the handler name. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

yyl_interpcasemod warns for an unpaired backslash-E case-modifier terminator. This is a redundant modifier, not regexp compilation. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
secondclass_keyword resolves an existing-name ambiguity to the CORE keyword when there is no applicable override, excluding the x keyword.
yyl_qw sees a comma in a whitespace-delimited word and warns once for the list because comma remains literal word content.
yyl_qw sees a hash character inside a word and warns once because qw does not parse comments.
yyl_qw sees backslash before whitespace rather than an escaped backslash and warns once because whitespace still separates words.
ampersand or bareword lexing expects an operator but starts a new line with a term, and temporarily attributes this heuristic warning to the preceding line.

The backslash-token scanner warns when a replacement expression uses a backslash digit as though it were a capture variable, before normal reference-constructor parsing. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

safe_bareword resolves an infix star, percent or ampersand as an operator and emits this independent warning after its missing-separator warning.
yyl_strictwarn_bareword finds an entirely lowercase unquoted token with no package stash and no preceding minus.
yyl_just_a_word recognizes a trailing-double-colon package bareword but finds no existing package stash.

keyword lexing recognizes any and creates the OP_ANYSTART block list operator.

keyword lexing recognizes role before parsing its name, version and attribute block.

operator lexing recognizes === and selects OP_EQU after its fake-EOF checks.

pending_ident cannot find the array or hash value for an interpolated aggregate name under its existing interpolation warning gates.

scan_ident parses a braced sigil name followed by an array/hash subscript and finds the name is also a keyword, reporting the selected element-access interpretation.
scan_ident closes a braced sigil name in normal or nested-bracket context and finds a keyword or existing CV with that name. The case is not restricted to hash dereferences.

The substitution tokenizer finds PMf_CONTINUE, which has no substitution effect. /e replacement evaluation is a separate concern.
scan_str finds a recognized extra opening paired delimiter and warns when its code point is not ASCII. This is not a count-range failure.
scan_str recognizes a currently unpaired opening delimiter reserved for future pairing. This is not a size/count failure.
The numeric lexer accepts a misplaced or repeated underscore while emitting at most one warning for the literal. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

The hexadecimal lexer compares a negative exponent against NV_MIN_EXP and the supported mantissa/subnormal allowance before warning. Preserve platform-dependent NV limits. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
The hexadecimal lexer warns when a nonnegative exponent exceeds NV_MAX_EXP minus one. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

After collecting a hexadecimal floating literal, the lexer compares significant_bits with NV_MANT_DIG. This detects representational precision loss, not an object or allocation overflow. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.

UNIVERSAL import/unimport fallback receives arguments for a package with no corresponding method, excluding _charnames and the separate fatal UNIVERSAL case. This is not an arbitrary missing method.
utf8_length, bytes_cmp_utf8 and check_utf8_print find insufficient bytes for the indicated sequence length and report the active operation or print fallback.
utf8_length and bytes_cmp_utf8 report a truncated sequence when there is no current operation.
bytes_cmp_utf8 finds a non-continuation byte after a downgradeable two-byte start, preserving its byte values and optional operation context.
to_case_cp_list has no mapping for a UTF-16 surrogate and warns before returning the original code point.
to_case_cp_list has no mapping for a super-Unicode code point within MAX_LEGAL_CP and returns it unchanged after warning; larger values use a separate fatal path.
check_locale_boundary_crossing rejects a mapping crossing the 255/256 boundary under a non-UTF-8 locale and copies the original character back.
to_utf8_fold_flags_ substitutes two long-s characters for capital sharp-s under locale folding, avoiding the byte-boundary crossing.
The SURSOLIDUM-guarded fold path substitutes two long-s characters for LATIN_SMALL_LIGATURE_LONG_S_WITH_DESCENDER_S under non-UTF-8 locale folding.
Locale folding substitutes the st ligature for the long-s-t ligature so its result stays above the byte boundary.
The Unicode 3.0.1-specific locale fold branch substitutes dotless-i for dotted capital I to avoid a byte-boundary crossing.
check_utf8_print detects an encoded surrogate in output, reports it and marks the stream content problematic.

OS2 launch fails ENOENT on the overridden argv-zero path that searches executable files rather than allowing script fallback.
OS2 spawn/exec exhausts its retry and shell fallback paths with a negative result and reports saved target/error context.
OS2 shell launch and Windows spawn handling report a negative result using the exec/spawn selector, target and errno. Selector-only input remains separate from template parameters.

VMS prime_env_iter sees a CRTL environ entry without an equals separator and cannot store its name/value.
VMS prime_env_iter receives SS$_BUFFEROVF from its enumeration subprocess and reports the truncated buffer before continuing parsing.
VMS prime_env_iter finds an empty parsed key or invalid quoted/numeric value bounds in a subprocess message and skips it.

vmssetenv warns when the number of logical-name equivalence segments exceeds the platform maximum and truncates to that byte limit. WARN_MISC controls its warning class; subject tags retain the operation family.
safe_popen cannot find VMSPIPE.COM and cannot create the fallback temporary script, so it warns and returns NULL. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
safe_popen receives failure from the VMS process creation service, maps status to errno and warns unless n mode suppresses it. Preserve the existing controlling warning category and emitter variants.
VMS waitpid emulation is polling a target whose owner is not this process and reports its nonstandard waiting behavior.
VMS exec translates the failing CLI/RMS/lib status into errno plus vaxc_errno and reports the command string.
VMS spawn translates a failing status into errno plus vaxc_errno and reports the error without a command-name parameter.

win32_sleep warns when seconds exceed UINT_MAX divided by 1000 before the existing millisecond multiplication. Preserve the existing return and platform conversion behavior. Keep existing warning control and all emitter variants.
gp_free finds a GP with zero gp_refcnt and returns after warning, retaining the interpreter suffix policy.

hv_iternext_flags with key randomization sees an altered traversal randomization value while the iterator is active. Preserve its historical WARN_INTERNAL control despite the user-visible each misuse.
unshare_hek_or_pvn cannot locate the supplied shared key in the string table, with its UTF-8 selector and interpreter suffix retained.
PerlIOScalar push/read/write cannot downgrade the backing SV to bytes and returns the existing IO error result.
The boundary check macro warns when a Unicode boundary runs under non-UTF-8 LC_CTYPE and continues with UTF-8 locale assumptions.
The regexp-set check macro sees a non-UTF-8 LC_CTYPE and ANYOFL_UTF8_LOCALE_REQD, then warns before using Unicode semantics.
del_sv in DEBUGGING fails to find the scalar pointer inside any registered scalar arena and returns after warning.

sv_free2 detects a free of a zero-reference-count non-immortal scalar outside artificial-break/global-cleanup exceptions, retaining the leaking-scalar debug alternatives.

grok_bslash_c warns only when the computed control escape is printable and warnings are allowed; it stores the clearer escaped/plain spelling in the collector. Preserve compatibility location attachment. Preserve WARN_SYNTAX and existing delivery behavior.

Encoding and decoding paths report a code point requiring Perl-extended UTF-8, with runtime category flags that may combine non-Unicode and portability controls. Use the generic catalog Warning class so construction derives the actual runtime category class or common ancestor instead of overriding it with a fixed subject class.

Use the generic catalog Warning class so construction derives the actual runtime category class or common ancestor instead of overriding it with a fixed subject class.
uvoffuni_to_utf8_flags_msgs reports a Unicode noncharacter when UNICODE_WARN_NONCHAR is set; the format macro also supplies the legacy message-returning API.
uvoffuni_to_utf8_flags_msgs reports a surrogate when UNICODE_WARN_SURROGATE is set; the format macro also supplies the legacy message-returning API.
